reference_check.compared: Preparation runs every kept QuixBugs test and 1,221 generated held-out tests (10 to 40 per program, expected values from the reference fix) against the reference fixes, and the buggy programs against their visible tests; the tests also re-check the fixes of 8 programs from the cached archive.
reference_check.result: All kept and generated tests pass on all 31 reference fixes; every buggy program fails at least one of its 129 visible tests (111 QuixBugs tests are held out). The seed repairs 6 programs (bitcount, find_first_in_sorted, get_factors, knapsack, next_permutation, quicksort) and its find_in_sorted patch passes the visible tests but fails held-out QuixBugs tests (counted as overfitting).
reference_check.notes: Per-test limits are CPU time (ITIMER_PROF), so machine load cannot turn a correct run into a time-out; the prepared file was re-derived with these limits and matched the lock.

reference_check.compared: Bounded model checking (up to 8 loop steps, Z3) of all 133 programs against the 9 invalid programs reported by Ryan et al. (ICLR 2020); a hand-written invariant and the counterexamples of a weaker one (unit tests); robustness of the oracle's resource accounting.
reference_check.result: Exactly 9 programs violate their post-condition (26, 27, 31, 32, 61, 62, 72, 75, 106, after 0 or 1 loop steps); none of the other 124 has a counterexample within 8 steps. (and (>= x 1) (>= y 0) (>= x y)) verifies program 1; (>= x y) fails consecution with a genuine successor state. The Houdini seed proves 63 of 124 using 875 queries; 'true' proves 5. All checks of the seed took at most 17 ms.

not_implemented.quixbugs-fault-localisation: The prepared QuixBugs spectra cover 31 programs of 6 to 11 executable lines with one fault each; rankings over so few lines and faults would not measure fault localisation meaningfully, so the fault-localisation task uses 532 seeded faults in three larger modules instead.
not_implemented.next-release-problem: No verified, licensed download of the realistic NRP instances (Xuan et al., TSE 2012) was found.
not_implemented.stamina-model-inference: The STAMINA competition site and the framework paper's host could not be reached (connection failure), so the original generation protocol and data could not be checked; not implemented.
not_implemented.refactory-assignment-repair: Considered (LGPL-3.0 data, 1,783 student programs) but not implemented in this round; it would repeat the program-repair problem already covered by the QuixBugs task.
not_implemented.abbadingo-dfa-learning: Considered; the original test labels are only available through the retired online oracle, so instances would have to be regenerated, and the problem is grammatical inference rather than software engineering proper.
